replay: Reuse B.1 target draft selection, canonical SQLite and unchanged k500 evidence snapshots. Score once; L-only ablations. Complete pack/pool/labels and supported coordinates required for comparative metrics.
positionalTraining: B.1 whole-draft evidence group only; independent C-seed 50/50 fit/audit split inside that group for confidence/pack-specific choice. No target-draft positions or own future picks enter feature fitting.
positionAudit: Mean, median, 10% trimmed mean and empirical CDF; global versus pack-specific; lambda 0/20/100/400 independent supporting drafts. Select confidence/lookup on equal-set calibration CDF CRPS, descriptive median/mean errors.
candidates: A: bounded positive raw lateness accumulator
qualityGate: clamp(2*(frozen k500 raw Q-.5),0,1); no intrinsic Q substitution; colorless/lands zero lane evidence; gold split evenly and downweight .5
safeguards: Current-pick position ramp max(0,min(1,(pick-2)/6)); per-observation color evidence capped, smooth tanh accumulator; supporting-position confidence. Same-direction old pack retention .5, exponential age by source global pick. Physical card/pack independence unavailable; do not claim repeated sightings independent.
primaryMetric: Equal-set, equal-pack/pick-stage next-3 same-pack quality-card availability multiclass Brier; next-1/5 and quality subsequent human-pick colors secondary; temporal params calibration only; family choice on development.
developmentGate: At least 1% improvement versus best of actual current-derived-L, uniform and current-pack-quality-mass predictor; improve 4/5 development sets; contextual Top1 and MRR no worse than current-derived-L; no worse false early-lock rate; no worse measured recovery; frozen Q/commitment golden pass. Otherwise no final release.
diagnostics: Build top-2 spell-color loads, completed observed pools, terminal records labels only. Early lock at P1 picks<=3 and leader-runner support gap>=.5/confidence>=.5; report .25/.5/.75 sensitivity. Reversal: different mono-color availability leaders at picks4-6 vs9-11, margins>=.05, report recovery by pick11 and latency.
holdouts: No release by default. Only after immutable selection and convincing development gate, exactly one exclusive release; otherwise refuse final. New holdouts remain untouched.
